artifact_observations.reasoning: The background rock/coral texture exhibits slight smearing and lack of high-frequency detail typical of AI-generated underwater scenes, appearing somewhat 'painted' rather than photographic.
The very tips of the longest dorsal spines fade into the background with an unnatural softness, lacking the sharp definition expected of rigid biological structures, suggesting minor generation blur.

Critical for verifying the structural integrity of the complex, thin dorsal spines and ensuring they do not fuse with the background or each other.
To assess the realism of the underwater lighting, water turbidity effects, and detect subtle generative artifacts in the background.
To verify correct spatial separation between the translucent fins and the rocky background, checking for depth bleeding.
